name: rust-lsp
description: rust-analyzer for Rust projects, checking into target/rust-analyzer so its background cargo check never waits on, or blocks, your own builds for the target directory lock. It leaves src-tauri/binaries out of its file watching: on Windows each watched folder holds a handle, and those handles block the rename of a large bundle there (a Tauri sidecar). Shortcut: this also hides a real src-tauri/binaries source folder in any other Rust project; upgrade to a per-project variant if one ever needs it. Needs rust-analyzer on PATH (rustup component add rust-analyzer).
